title: opto-sync merge options
description: Canonical language-neutral options accepted by opto-sync reconciliation engines. Host-language APIs may expose idiomatic names, but JSON and JavaScript boundaries use these camelCase keys and integer strategy codes.

maxDepth.description: Maximum object nesting depth; zero means unlimited.

lwwKeys.description: Comma-separated last-write-wins selectors; null uses updatedAt.

fwwKeys.description: Comma-separated first-write-wins selectors; null disables FWW.

arrayMatchKeys.description: Comma-separated merge-by-key identity selectors; null uses id.
